metas.name: Gentle Monster
metas.description: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

metas.name: Guarding Stars
metas.description: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

metas.name: Madden
metas.description: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football's most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

metas.name: Appofeniacs
metas.description: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

metas.name: Queen at Sea
metas.description: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

metas.name: A Talent for Murder
metas.description: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

metas.name: LA BOLA NEGRA
metas.description: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

metas.name: Extra Geography
metas.description: In an English girls boarding school, two teenage best friends grapple with the challenges of girlhood—friendship, boys, studies, and growing up—and embark on their school project... falling in love.

metas.name: The Beast
metas.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

metas.name: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
metas.description: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

metas.name: Never Surrender
metas.description: When a deadly gang descends on his remote home, a guilt-ridden veteran and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must unite to survive.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

metas.name: Heartland
metas.description: Former country music legend Misty Jones returns to Nashville to unravel the truth behind her rising-star niece's disappearance.

metas.name: Being Heumann
metas.description: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

metas.name: Urchin
metas.description: Mike, a rough sleeper in London, is trapped in a cycle of self-destruction as he attempts to turn his life around. Along the way, he encounters unexpected chances for a fresh start.

metas.name: Avengers: Doomsday
metas.description: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

metas.name: De Gaulle: Liberté
metas.description: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.
